verdict.rationale: The only official library in the evidence is Cal Atoms, a set of first-party React components with a platform quickstart and managed users that developers build scheduling into their apps with; it works as a UI-level SDK. The rest is a REST API v2, an official CLI and a hosted MCP server, none of which is a general-purpose programmatic SDK. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path, so a generated client is not evidenced either. missing for 10: official typed API client SDKs (e.g. TypeScript/Python) wrapping API v2, a published OpenAPI spec for codegen, SDK reference docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
